completion_data.completion_summary: Added project-aware filtering to both literature scripts: detect_project() in literature-retrieve.sh adds project hint to Tier 1 tool block and pre-filters Tier 2 keyword entries by project_tags; --project flag in literature-search.sh builds doc_id IN set from index.json for SQL filtering with zero-result fallback.

memory_candidates.content: When adding project-scoped filtering to FTS5 SQLite search (literature-search.sh), the pattern is: (1) parse --project flag before subcommand dispatch with a pre-scan loop; (2) load allowed doc_ids from index.json via jq with case-insensitive matching; (3) inject AND d.doc_id IN (placeholders) into SQL when doc_ids are non-empty; (4) re-run without filter on zero results for graceful fallback. This avoids adding project_tags column to SQLite and keeps the filter logic in bash/Python rather than the DB schema.
